title: Linux virtual machine (private, Entra ID login)
description: An Ubuntu LTS virtual machine with no public IP address, SSH keys only (passwords disabled), Entra ID SSH login, Trusted Launch (secure boot + vTPM), a managed identity and automatic OS patching.
security_defaults: No public IP address: reach it through Bastion, a VPN or a jump host
Password sign-in disabled; SSH public key required; Entra ID login extension installed
Trusted Launch: secure boot and virtual TPM; automatic platform patching

subnet_id.description: Subnet for the VM's private network interface.

admin_ssh_public_key.description: SSH PUBLIC key for the admin user (ssh-rsa ... or ssh-ed25519 ...). Never a private key.

admin_username.description: Local admin user name (not root or admin).

zone.description: Availability zone (omit for none). Cannot be changed later.

entra_login_enabled.description: Install the Entra ID SSH login extension.

encryption_at_host_enabled.description: Encrypt temp disks and caches on the host. Requires the EncryptionAtHost feature to be registered on the subscription.

notes: To sign in with Entra ID, a user needs the 'Virtual Machine Administrator Login' or 'Virtual Machine User Login' role; grant it separately.
If the subnet is in another resource group, the agent's identity needs permission to join it.
